Fire has gutted a bungalow at Okenwa Housing Estate, behind Tourist Gardens Hotels, near the Anambra State Government House in Awka, destroying property and household appliances. No casualties were recorded in the incident, which occurred on Sunday. The Anambra State Fire Service said preliminary observations suggested that the fire might have been triggered by a spark from an electrical circuit, although the suspected cause was yet to be confirmed. In a statement issued on Monday, the service’s Media and Publicity Unit, led by Chukwudi Chiketa, said firefighters responded to a distress call and successfully extinguished the blaze, preventing it from spreading to adjoining properties. Chiketa said the emergency call was received at approximately 9:40am after residents reported the incident to the fire station. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. It said the affected area was secured after the firefighting operation, adding that personnel withdrew from the scene at approximately 12:40pm. The service urged residents to ensure proper electrical installations, avoid overloading electrical circuits and promptly repair faulty wiring to reduce the risk of fire outbreaks. It also advised residents to report fire emergencies promptly to enable a swift response and minimise damage to lives and property.
